<title level="1" right="Rules">[Movement](/Rules.aspx?ID=165)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 218 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Your familiar has either a Speed of 25 feet or a swim Speed of 25 feet (choose one upon gaining the familiar). It can gain other movement types from familiar abilities.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
